$comment: VR2 release-evidence manifest TEMPLATE. Copy this per ticket to artifacts/visual-recovery-audit-v2/<ticket>/evidence-manifest.json, fill every field from the verified candidate runtime, then run: npm run vr2:gate -- artifacts/visual-recovery-audit-v2/<ticket>/evidence-manifest.json . `image` paths are relative to the repo root and MUST exist on disk. implementationCommit MUST equal candidateRuntimeCommit (the runtime you captured is the exact candidate). Every capture names route, state (from the ticket's declared states), viewport, locale, reducedMotion. The gate enforces a per-locale matrix: EACH required locale (de, en) must carry BOTH required viewports (1440x900, 1280x800); add a reducedMotion:true capture when the ticket owns motion. `target` (or `targets`, an array) references the approved board and MUST use an anchor the ticket owns that resolves to a board target-<id> article (see tools/vr2/route-state-manifest.json). A ticket that owns several board targets can use `targets` and per-capture `target` overrides.
